tools.name: list_magazine_articles
tools.description: List the launch-cohort magazine essays on selection science and better management. Known slugs (7): how-to-tell-whos-good, the-numbers-moved, structure-is-the-tool, grading-on-vibes, score-before-you-talk, two-thousand-jobs, ….

tools.name: get_magazine_article
tools.description: Returns one Get2Great magazine essay as structured content: metadata, markdown body, and citations. Use slug how-to-tell-whos-good for the lead essay on telling who is good at the job.

tools.name: search_magazine_articles
tools.description: Substring search across magazine title, dek, pattern, and body.

tools.name: list_management_tools
tools.description: List the Get2Great-lane manager-facing tools (strategy frameworks + management/HR practice). Metadata only — execution endpoints are auth-gated elsewhere.

tools.name: get_cohort_status
tools.description: Returns the published filing count for a Get2Great Snowball cohort (default: turnover). A count below the release threshold is withheld — filed is null, below_reporting_threshold is true. Valid verticals: turnover, engineering-ttf, saas-frt.

tools.name: list_get2great_feeds
tools.description: List Get2Great's free machine-readable feeds. OpenAPI at https://get2great.com/openapi.json.

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_membership_offer" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.
